title: Stage Fright on a Summer Night
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie perform in Shakespeare's play and save a dancing bear in old London! / 杰克和安妮在古老的伦敦登上莎士比亚的舞台，还救了一只会跳舞的熊！🎭

q.en: In this book, where do Jack and Annie travel to?
q.zh: 在这本书里，杰克和安妮去了哪里？

options.zh: 英格兰的伊丽莎白时代伦敦

explain.en: The tree house takes them to London, England, in the time of Queen Elizabeth the First, where they find a theater by the River Thames.
explain.zh: 树屋把他们带到了伊丽莎白一世时代的英格兰伦敦，在那里他们找到了泰晤士河边的一座剧院。

q.en: What play do Jack and Annie perform at the Globe Theater?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮在环球剧院演出的是哪部剧？

options.en: The Winter's Tale and the Bear

explain.en: Will, the playwright, needs two boys to play fairies in his play A Midsummer Night's Dream, so Jack and Annie join the show.
explain.zh: 剧作家威尔需要两个男孩扮演精灵，出演《仲夏夜之梦》，于是杰克和安妮加入了演出。

q.en: Why does Annie pretend to be a boy named Andy?
q.zh: 安妮为什么要假装成一个叫安迪的男孩？

options.en: She wanted to hide from the bear's owner
options.zh: 她想躲开熊的主人，不过那是另一个故事了

options.en: Girls were not allowed on the stage
options.zh: 女孩当时不允许登台表演

options.en: She was afraid of the dancing bear
options.zh: 她害怕那只会跳舞的熊

explain.en: In old England it was against the law for girls to act, so boys played all the girls' parts; Annie tucks up her hair and becomes 'Andy.'
explain.zh: 在旧时的英格兰，女孩登台演戏是违法的，所有女性角色都由男孩扮演；安妮把头发扎起来，成了「安迪」。

q.en: What is the name of the tame bear Annie wants to save?
q.zh: 安妮想救的那只温顺的熊叫什么名字？

explain.en: The bear's cage is labeled 'Dan the Dancing Bear'; he is a lonely, tame brown bear, not a fighter.
explain.zh: 熊笼上写着「会跳舞的熊丹」；他是一只孤独而温顺的棕色熊，并不是好斗的熊。

q.en: What 'special magic' do Jack and Annie find in London?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮在伦敦找到了什么「特别的魔法」？

options.en: The magic of talking with animals
The magic of theater — turning daytime into night
options.zh: 戏剧的魔力——把白天变成夜晚

options.en: The magic of turning the dark night back into bright daytime
options.zh: 把漆黑的夜晚重新变回明亮白天的魔力

options.en: The magic of flying through the air

explain.en: Queen Elizabeth tells the players they gave a special kind of magic — the magic of theater — and 'turned the very daytime into night.'
explain.zh: 伊丽莎白女王说演员们带来了一种特别的魔法——戏剧的魔力，并「把大白天变成了夜晚」。

q.en: Why did Queen Elizabeth have black teeth?
q.zh: 伊丽莎白女王的牙齿为什么是黑色的？

explain.en: Will explains that the queen's teeth were black from eating too much sugar, as were many people's teeth in that time.
explain.zh: 威尔解释说，女王的牙齿因为吃太多糖而变黑，那个时代很多人的牙齿也都是这样。

q.en: Who is the man called Will at the Globe Theater?
q.zh: 环球剧院里那个叫威尔的人是谁？

options.en: The cross old owner of the dancing bear
options.zh: 会跳舞的熊那位生气的主人

explain.en: Will is the long-legged playwright with a trim beard and twinkly eyes; he is William Shakespeare, who wrote the play they perform.
explain.zh: 威尔是那位长腿、留着整齐胡子、眼睛炯炯有神的剧作家，他就是威廉·莎士比亚，写出了他们演的那出戏。

q.en: How much did it cost to stand and watch the play?
q.zh: 站着看这出戏要花多少钱？

explain.en: A man at the door shouts 'A penny to stand!' because people dropped a penny into the box to stand in the open area below the stage.
explain.zh: 门口的人喊着「站票一便士！」，因为人们把一便士投进箱子，就能站在舞台下方的空地里看戏。

q.en: Which character is called the 'merry wanderer of the night'?
q.zh: 哪个角色被称作「夜晚快乐的漫游者」？

explain.en: Puck is the chubby, curly-haired actor in green who leads Jack and Annie onstage and is called the 'merry wanderer of the night.'
explain.zh: 帕克是那个胖胖的、卷头发、穿绿衣的演员，他把杰克和安妮带上台，被称为「夜晚快乐的漫游者」。

q.en: How does Will help the tame bear Dan?
q.zh: 威尔是怎样帮助温顺的熊丹的？

options.en: He sets Dan free in the forest
He buys Dan with gold coins for a play
options.zh: 他付金币买下丹，写进戏里

options.en: He sends the tame dancing bear Dan back to his angry owner
options.zh: 他把温顺的会跳舞的熊丹送回给那位愤怒的主人

options.en: He sells Dan to the fights

explain.en: Will gives the bear's owner gold coins and says he plans to write a play with a part for a bear, then Puck leads Dan to the stables.
explain.zh: 威尔给了熊的主人金币，说想写一出有熊角色的戏，接着帕克把丹领到了马厩。
